category.value: Smash & Auto Body Repairs / Panel Beaters & Painters

services.name: Collision & Smash Repairs
services.description: Structural and cosmetic collision recovery for private and insured vehicles across all makes and models, from minor urban bingles to multi-panel accident damage.

services.name: Panel Beating & Dent Removal
services.description: Precision steel and aluminium panel reshaping, door skin and guard replacements, crease extraction, and factory panel gap alignment.

services.name: Spray Painting & Colour Matching
services.description: Oven-baked two-pack refinishing, spectrophotometer paint matching, clear-coat blending, and paintwork restoration.

services.name: Bumper, Scuff & Scratch Repairs
services.description: Plastic bumper welding, corner scuff refinishing, deep key-scratch repair, and stone-chip rectification.

services.name: Chassis & Frame Alignment
services.description: Underbody and structural measuring to verify straight factory geometry before outer panels are refitted.

services.name: Insurance & Private Quotes
services.description: Straightforward damage assessments and written repair estimates for insurance claims or private out-of-pocket repairs.
